description.en:
Returns how many players of one team currently have their Fighting Spirit out on the pitch ("avater" is the game's spelling of avatar). It counts the team's players on the pitch whose Fighting Spirit flag is set, the same flag CMND_BTL_HAS_AVATER reads for one player and CMND_BTL_SET_AVATER sets.
The story matches check it before summoning a Fighting Spirit with CMND_BTL_SET_AVATER: when three or more are already out, they first dismiss one of them with CMND_BTL_RESET_AVATER(0) (the one with the lowest gauge).
Team to count: 0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent team. Any other value gives 0.

Number of players of that team with their Fighting Spirit out.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument was given.

examples.case: Making room before a scripted summon (real usage, from btl0011.nut)
Same check, sparing a player whose Fighting Spirit is not out (real usage, from btl0014.nut)
